# Huge congrats to the whole Assured team on our $19M Series A 🎉 · 2026-07-22T00:00:00+00:00

Huge congrats to the whole Assured team on our $19M Series A 🎉

I joined as AE #3 when we were a scrappy team of ~15 in a small office on 31st and 6th. We grew to ~30 there before we outgrew the space, and now we're in our new ~65 person office on 7th and 28th, where I get to work alongside this team in person 5 days a week. Best group of coworkers I've ever worked with, genuinely bright people who've also become close friends.

What brought me here is the mission. Rahul and Varun lived this problem firsthand as founders of Dawn Health. Credentialing and enrollment was the thing that kept them from scaling, they tried legacy vendors, tried bringing it in house, none of it worked well enough. They eventually sold Dawn Health and built Assured to fix the exact pain they lived through. I believed in that vision from day one, and watching us build AI agents to actually solve it (not just software to manage it) has been incredible to be part of.

# Exclusive: Former Meta And Slack Engineers Raise $15M For New Startup Centralize To Build A ‘Deal GPS’ For Enterprise Sales

Mary Ann Azevedo

July 29, 2026

 

While working as a product tech lead at a startup, Rachit Kataria watched a multi-hundred-thousand-dollar enterprise account suddenly fall into jeopardy. 

After pausing his entire engineering team’s workload for two weeks to ship a requested fix, he discovered the effort made no difference. The customer still threatened to churn.

“We did a retro, and wouldn’t you know? The person who’s asking for the new request was the new decision maker [we] didn’t even realize existed,” said Kataria, co-founder and CEO of San Francisco-based Centralize, in an interview. “We missed the fact that the prior person had left, and the context had shifted hands, and no one had tracked that.”
